info.name: Smart Solar Microgrid Trading System - API
info.description:
API tests for the Smart Solar Microgrid Trading System (SLIIT SE4040).

## How to use

1. Start the API: `cd api/Microgrid.Api` then `dotnet run`
2. Check the `baseUrl` variable matches where it is listening (default `http://localhost:5288`)
3. Open the **Auth - Success** folder and run **1. Login - Backoffice** first. It saves the token automatically, so every later request is already authorised.
4. Or press **Run** on the collection to run everything in order.

Every request has tests attached, so you can see pass/fail instead of reading the JSON yourself.

## Folders

- **Health** - checks the API is up and MongoDB is reachable
- **Auth - Success** - the happy path: login, who am I, Backoffice-only access
- **Auth - Failure** - wrong password, missing token, bad input
- **Auth - Role and Status** - needs extra test accounts, see the folder description
- **C - Energy reservations** - book, change, cancel and approve; 7 day, 12 hour and station deactivation rules. Self-contained, run it as a folder

Batch F1 covers login only. User management endpoints arrive in batch A2.

Logs in the Backoffice user created automatically at startup.

Staff log in with their email. Prosumers log in with their NIC - the same field and the same endpoint handles both.

The token is saved into the `token` collection variable, so you do not need to copy and paste it anywhere.

request.description:
Reads the user id out of the token and returns that user's details.

Both clients use this to restore a session and to show the user's name. `nic` is null here because this is a staff account, not a prosumer.

A Backoffice-only endpoint, protected with `[Authorize(Roles = Roles.Backoffice)]`.

The role is read from the signed token, not from anything the client sends, so a client cannot promote itself.

A user that does not exist.

Important: the message is identical to the wrong-password case. If it said "no such user", an attacker could use the endpoint to find out which accounts exist.

request.description: No details at all. The `[Required]` attributes on LoginRequest reject this before any service code runs.
A protected endpoint called with no Authorization header. The JWT middleware rejects it before the controller runs.
No token at all. 401 means "I do not know who you are".
A made-up token. The signature does not match the server's secret key, so it is rejected. This proves a client cannot write its own token.

item.name: A2a - Staff management (Backoffice only)
item.description:
Staff accounts: Backoffice and Grid Operator. Every endpoint here requires a Backoffice token.

Run **Auth - Success > 1. Login - Backoffice** first so `{{token}}` and `{{adminUserId}}` are set. The GridOperator test needs `{{operatorToken}}` from the Auth - Role and Status folder.

Each run creates one new Grid Operator with a unique email (there is no delete endpoint by design; accounts are deactivated, not deleted).

item.name: A2b - Prosumer accounts
item.description:
Prosumer registration, profile and approval. The NIC is the account id.

Run **Auth - Success > 1. Login - Backoffice** first for `{{token}}`. The last check needs `{{operatorToken}}` from the Auth - Role and Status folder.

Each run registers a prosumer with a fresh NIC, so the folder can be run repeatedly. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted, which is why old test prosumers stay in the list.

item.name: C - Energy reservations
item.description:
Energy slot reservations (Member C): create, update, cancel and approve, with the 7 day rule (rule 5), the 12 hour rule (rule 6) and the station deactivation block (rule 7).

**Self-contained:** the C-0x/C-1x setup requests create their own Grid Operator, two prosumers, a station and slots, so this folder only needs the API running and the seeded Backoffice account. Run the whole folder with **Run folder**, in order - later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.

Slot times are worked out at run time, so the rules give the same result whenever it is run. Each run adds new test records; nothing is deleted.
